entities.title: Chess rules (GDScript)
entities.summary: The rules of chess for the board in the game: positions, legal moves, SAN, check, mate and draws.
entities.purpose: The global class Chess: positions as 64 squares, moves packed into ints, legal move generation, UCI and SAN, and Chess.Game, a game as its UCI moves with every position and the result the board decides. No scene tree, no I/O.
boundaries: The server judges online games with its own rules (shared/rules.ts on chess.js); this folder decides only what the client shows and lets the player try.
Draws by agreement, resignation and the like are the game screen's and the server's; Chess.Game only knows what the board decides.
